premises.text: People have unknowingly relinquished control of images, content, and digital life history that storage makes forever public
premises.evidence_span: We have unknowingly relinquished real control of our digital life

premises.text: Social Fortress travels with messages and photos on any device, platform, and application so users stay in control of their data
premises.evidence_span: you need Jason Bourne standing with your data no matter where it goes, anywhere in the world, on any device, on any platform, and on any application

premises.text: The same control works for enterprise, mobile, and consumer apps in real time without being a VPN, SSO, DRM, MDM, or encryption gateway
premises.evidence_span: Social Fortress works for the enterprise, it works for mobile, it works for the consumer, and it works real time

value.text: Users and organizations regain control of their digital content wherever it travels
value.evidence_span: They're in control of their data

causal_links.evidence_span: We are all out of control
Social Fortress brings Jason Bourne to all your messages, all your photos
